answer: Each identity posts a refundable work bond that unlocks only when it spends unique, non-transferable task lots drawn from a rotating lottery. Cheap clones can sprout in the meadow of open registration, but they cannot share lots: a receipt already claimed is burned, so a farm must buy and finish a fresh lot per fake. The scarce tundra of high-skill lots further caps throughput. A hollow identity with reused or empty receipts never unlocks its bond, turning mass cloning into locked, unproductive capital.
